children: Cornerstone investors in Zhaowei Electromechanical (02692), Estun (02715) and Megmeet (03268) will see shares unlocked on September 9 and September 10, according to ETNet.

For Zhaowei Electromechanical, the unlocks on September 9 include 1.6448 million shares for HHLRA, 548,200 shares each for Mirae Asset Securities HK and Oakwise Growth Fund, and 657,900 shares for Perseverance Asset Management. Other investors on the list include Dacheng International, GF Fund Hong Kong, Jump Trading, VVC Technology, FMF, Taihu Jingu, Tuosi Global, Shuangcheng Capital and CCB International (for over-the-counter swaps), Hengbang and China Galaxy International Investment (for Hengbang OTC swaps), Wenying Investment, Cunran Capital, He Maoling, Luo Jie, Lianyue Group, Minsheng International, Wusong and Wanyuan Capital.

For Estun, the September 9 unlock list includes 10.1772 million shares for Harvest Oriental, 7.633 million shares for Hong Tong Optoelectronics International, 5.2082 million shares for Dream'ee HK Fund, 5.0886 million shares for Zhiyuan, 2.4814 million shares for Haitian Huayuan, 1.9336 million shares for Yuxiang and 1.5266 million shares for Qianhai Hezhong Investment.

For Megmeet, the September 10 unlock list includes 7.7269 million shares for Baoyuehu Shenzhen Industrial Investment Co-Managed Enterprise, 1.3541 million shares for Mankyo Electronics Hong Kong, 1.0833 million shares for Ruiming Electronics, 1.7325 million shares each for Harvest International Premium Value (Secondary Market) Fund SPC representing Harvest Oriental SP and Zhou Zengchang, 406,200 shares for Jinyi Capital Multi-Strategy Fund SPC Ltd., 1.0395 million shares for Kaipan Wealth Management, and 812,400 shares for Zhongxing.

title: IPO Cornerstone Investors Face Lock-Up Expiry For Zhaowei Electromechanical, Estun, And Megmeet
